title: 第15章 一门双龙第16章 一掌抽晕
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
“干得好！
你放心，等我父亲当上家主之后，一定会重重有赏。”
叶强露出得意的笑容。
“多谢叶强少爷！”
那个下人大喜。
演武场中的擂台之上，叶家的年轻子弟，轮流上台，进行比赛。
擂台四周，阵阵喝采声如雷。
东边的高台之上，叶家的高层们，也是十分关注族中年轻子弟们的比赛。
时不时，出言点评。
比赛进行了大约两个时辰之后。
一个紫衣少女，表现突出，逐渐成为擂台上的焦点。
这个紫衣少女，叫叶雪，炼体七重，叶家年轻一辈的佼佼者。
她为人直爽，不拘小节，有大姐大的风范，在年轻一辈中颇有人气。
“雪姐，我认输！”
擂台上，一个年轻人，被叶雪一剑逼到擂台的边缘，犀利的剑尖，朝他的喉咙刺来，吓得他脸色发白，大叫了起来。
叶雪收住长剑。
那个年轻人满脸通红，逃下擂台。
他虽然也是炼体七重的实力，但是，不到十招，就败在叶雪的剑下。
“雪姐威武！”
擂台周围，响起阵阵欢呼声。

接下来又有几个年轻子弟，陆续上台，挑战叶雪，不过，都是失败。
“雪姐威武！”
……
一时之间，叶雪成了全场的焦点。
“雪儿天赋，真的不错，从现在开始，她的修炼资源，要酌情增加。”
东边的高台之上，叶天鹏开声说道。
其他的叶家高层，也是纷纷点头，表示赞成。
天赋资质越好，所获得的修炼资源，就越多。
这是绝大部分武道世家，培养年轻子弟的方式。
“还有谁上来挑战我的！”
此时，擂台之上，叶雪再一次，打败了一个挑战者，环顾全场，高声喝道。
“算了，雪姐，除了叶雷和叶天风，没人打得过你的了。”
“你把擂台让出来，给机会我们表演一下吧。”
……
叶家年轻一代，已经没有人上去挑战叶雪了。
“好吧。”
叶雪见没人上台，只好放弃，准备跳下擂台。
突然。
“叶雪，我来挑战你！”
content_en:
"Well done!
Don't worry, when my father becomes the head of the family, he will definitely be richly rewarded. "
Ye Qiang showed a proud smile.
"Thank you, Master Ye Qiang!"
The servant was overjoyed.
On the stage in the martial arts arena, the young disciples of the Ye family took turns taking the stage to compete.
There were thunderous cheers all around the arena.
On the high platform to the east, the senior leaders of the Ye family are also paying close attention to the competition of the younger members of the family.
From time to time, make comments.
The game lasted about two hours.
A girl in purple performed outstandingly and gradually became the focus of the ring.
This girl in purple is called Ye Xue, she is at the seventh level of physical training and is the leader of the younger generation of the Ye family.
She is straightforward, informal, and has a sisterly demeanor, making her quite popular among the younger generation.
"Sister Xue, I admit defeat!"
On the ring, a young man was forced to the edge of the ring by Ye Xue's sword. The sharp sword tip stabbed him in the throat. He turned pale with fright and screamed.
Ye Xue put away her sword.
The young man fled off the ring with his face flushed.
Although he was also at the seventh level of body refining, he was defeated by Ye Xue's sword in less than ten moves.
"Sister Xue is mighty!"
There were bursts of cheers around the arena.
Then several young people came on stage one after another to challenge Ye Xue, but they all failed.
"Sister Xue is mighty!"
…
Suddenly, Ye Xue became the focus of the audience.
"Xue'er's talent is really good. From now on, her training resources will be increased as appropriate."
On the high platform to the east, Ye Tianpeng said loudly.
Other senior members of the Ye family also nodded in agreement.
The better your talent and qualifications are, the more training resources you will get.
This is the way most martial arts families train their young disciples.
"Who else comes up to challenge me!"
At this time, on the ring, Ye Xue once again defeated a challenger, looked around the audience, and shouted loudly.
"Forget it, Sister Xue, no one can beat you except Ye Lei and Ye Tianfeng."
"Please give up the stage and give us a chance to perform."
…
No one from the younger generation of the Ye family would challenge Ye Xue.
"Okay."
Seeing that no one was on stage, Ye Xue had to give up and prepared to jump off the ring.
Sudden.
"Ye Xue, let me challenge you!"
